name: trustguard
description: TrustGuard AI firewall for Claude Code (lifecycle hooks) plus TrustGate MCP Gateway. Claude Code prompts for the MCP URL when you enable the plugin; auth is OAuth.

trustgate_mcp_url.title: TrustGate MCP URL
trustgate_mcp_url.description: Full MCP endpoint from TrustGate Connect (e.g. https://host/consumer-slug/mcp). Auth is OAuth — no API key.
